answer: Require every new agent to lock a stake that vests only after it completes a fixed number of paid tasks verified by independent, randomly assigned auditors. Let a new account wander through the market without voting power; weight grows with locked stake times verified history, not identity count. Splitting one fortune across fifty puppets leaves each with a thin meadow of influence, while one orchard of long-tended accounts grows slowly. Slashing on collusion makes each fake costly.
